gloss: plan that falls through; plan never carried out

definitions.gloss: plan that falls through; plan never carried out
definitions.explanation: A plan that looked good on paper but was never put into practice, or that collapsed partway. Often used of resolutions and projects.

examples.japanese: {計画倒|けいかくだお}れ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{終|お}わった。
examples.english: It came to nothing but a plan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{立派|りっぱ}→立派：01093_rippa⟧な⟦{目標|もくひょう}→目標：03631_mokuhyou⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{実行|じっこう}しなければ→実行する：22146_jikkousuru⟧{計画倒|けいかくだお}れだ。
examples.english: Even a fine goal is just a failed plan if you don't act on it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧⟦{日記|にっき}→日記：01486_nikki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つけよう⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{決|き}める→決める：00858_kimeru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{三日|みっか}→三日：02969_mikka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{計画倒|けいかくだお}れ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Every year I decide to keep a diary, but it always falls apart after three days.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {計画倒|けいかくだお}れ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{終|お}わる: to end up as a plan that came to nothing
- {計画倒|けいかくだお}れ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to fall through

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{三日坊主|みっかぼうず}→三日坊主：06021_mikkabouzu⟧: someone who gives up after a short time (about the person, not the plan)
- ⟦{絵|え}→絵：02613_e⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{描|か}いた→描く：28436_kaku⟧⟦{餅|もち}→餅：03900_mochi⟧: a plan that exists only on paper, never realistic in the first place
